title: Igenamiterere
subtitle: Ururimi, umubare muto uhishwa, amakosa y'igerageza, igihe cy'akazi no gusubiza igerageza ku ntangiriro.
languageHint: Bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho kandi bigumaho nyuma yo kongera gufungura cyangwa nta murandasi. Imibare ni imwe mu ndimi zose.

threshold.label: Umubare muto uhishwa (igerageza)
threshold.description: Imibare irenze zeru kandi iri munsi y'uyu mubare ihishwa ku mbonerahamwe zose, ku bisobanuro birambuye no ku madosiye ya CSV.
threshold.readOnly: Bishyirwaho n'umuyobozi wa porogaramu (politiki y'igerageza, ntiyemerewe gukoreshwa nyabyo).
threshold.hint: Umubare wuzuye kuva kuri {{min}} kugeza kuri {{max}}. {{min}} ni wo muto wemewe n'imiyoborere.
threshold.justificationHint: Inyuguti {{min}}–{{max}}, byandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura (zimaze kuba {{count}}).
threshold.auditNote: Iri hinduka ryandikwa mu igenzura hamwe n'agaciro gashaje, agashya n'impamvu yawe.
threshold.preview: Kuri k = {{k}}, imibare {{n}} mu Incamake y'ubu yahishwa.

validation.range: Andika umubare wuzuye kuva kuri 3 kugeza kuri 20
validation.unchanged: Uyu ni wo mubare usanzwe ukoreshwa.

conflict.title: Umubare wahinduwe n'undi muntu
conflict.description: Ihinduka ryawe ntiryabitswe. Gumana agaciro gaheruka cyangwa ushyireho akawe hejuru yako.

threshold.notSaved: Ntibyabitswe — ongera ugerageze. Ibyo wanditse biracyahari.
threshold.forbidden: Umuyobozi wa porogaramu wenyine ni we ushobora guhindura uyu mubare. Igerageza ryanditswe.

faults.title: Kwigana amakosa y'igerageza
faults.description: Igana ibibazo by'umurandasi urebe uko buri paji yitwara. Nta serivisi nyayo irimo.
faults.serverErrorHint: Gusaba binanirwa mbere yo gukora (nta kibikwa).
faults.timeoutHint: Ibyanditswe birabikwa ariko igisubizo kikabura; kongera kugerageza ntibigomba kubyikuba.
faults.offlineHint: Buri gusaba kunanirwa nk'aho umurandasi wabuze.
faults.conflictHint: Kubika gukurikira kwitwara nk'aho undi muntu yabanje guhindura umubare.
faults.footnote: Ni ibikoresho by'igerageza gusa: guhindura amakosa si ibyemezo by'akazi kandi ntibiri mu nyandiko z'igenzura ry'imiyoborere. Gusubiza igerageza ku ntangiriro birabikuraho.

session.title: Igihe cy'igerageza
session.expireHint: Rangiza igihe ugerageze ibiba iyo kwinjira kurangiye: igikorwa gikurikira kizagusaba kongera kwinjira kigusubize aho wari uri.
session.expiredToast: Igihe cyarangiye. Igikorwa gikurikira kizagusaba kongera kwinjira.
session.expiredStatus: Iki gihe cyarangiye. Fungura indi paji cyangwa ukore igikorwa wongere winjire.

reset.title: Gusubiza igerageza ku ntangiriro
reset.description: Bisubiza ibintu uko byari biri: amakuru, igitabo cy'igenzura, igenamiterere, isaha y'igerageza. Birangiza iki gihe.
reset.dialogDescription: Ibyahinduwe byose muri iri gerageza bivanwaho kandi usubira ku kwinjira.
reset.confirm: Andika RESET kugira ngo usubize amakuru y'igerageza
reset.confirmHint: Andika ijambo {{token}} uko riri, mu nyuguti nkuru.
